column20: Intro/Due to: 'The incident occurred due to human error and insufficient validation safeguards during a routine abuse remediation'
column21: Intro: 'disabling the production R2 Gateway service responsible for the R2 API'; R2 Gateway is the shared 'front door' for R2
column22: 'All customers using Cloudflare R2 would have observed a 100% failure rate against their R2 buckets and objects'
column23: 'All customers using Cloudflare R2 would have observed a 100% failure rate'; 'a number of other Cloudflare services that depend on R2' — no zone or region limit named
column24: 'all other components of R2 remained up'; 'Separation of concerns and blast radius management meant that the underlying R2 infrastructure was unaffected'
column25: 'remediation and recovery was inhibited by the lack of direct controls to revert the product disablement action and the need to engage an operations team with lower level access'; recovery required a forced re-deployment at 09:09-09:13
column26: 'insufficient validation safeguards in our admin tooling, the R2 Gateway service was taken down as part of a routine remediation'; 'Product disablement actions in the abuse review UI have been disabled'
column27: V8a: 'All customers using Cloudflare R2 would have observed a 100% failure rate'; V8c: 'User-facing requests for assets to sites with Cache Reserve did not observe failures as cache misses failed over to the origin'; V8b: no statement on an independent second provider
column28: Human-error mis-scoped abuse-remediation disablement coded as config_change because the action was an administrative product-disablement; V1b and V8b left unstated.
